text_en: After this Absalom got himself a chariot and horses, and fifty men to run ahead of him.
text_cn: 这事以后，阿贝沙隆准备了车辆和骏马，并叫五十个人为他开道。

text_en: Absalom used to rise early and stand beside the road into the gate; and when anyone brought a suit before the king for judgment, Absalom would call out and say, “From what city are you? ” When the person said, “Your servant is of such and such a tribe in Israel, ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆常清早起来，站在进城门的大路旁；凡有争讼，要到君王前去要求裁判的人，阿贝沙隆就把他叫到自己跟前来问说：“你是哪一城里的人？”他答说：“你仆人是以色列某支派的人。”

text_en: Absalom would say, “See, your claims are good and right; but there is no one deputed by the king to hear you. ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆就向他说：“看，你的案件是正直有理的，但是君王没有派人来听取你的案件。”

text_en: Absalom said moreover, “If only I were judge in the land! Then all who had a suit or cause might come to me, and I would give them justice. ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆又接着说：“唉！谁若立我作了国家的判官，凡是有诉讼和案件的，来到我这里，我必使他获得公正的裁判。”

text_en: Whenever people came near to do obeisance to him, he would put out his hand and take hold of them, and kiss them.
text_cn: 若有人近前来叩拜他，他就伸手将他抱住，与他亲吻。

text_en: Thus Absalom did to every Israelite who came to the king for judgment; so Absalom stole the hearts of the people of Israel.
text_cn: 凡是要到君王前去告状的以色列人，阿贝沙隆总是这样对待他们；如此他获得了以色列人的心。

text_en: At the end of four years Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go to Hebron and pay the vow that I have made to the Lord .
text_cn: 四年以后，阿贝沙隆向君王说：“我求大王让我去赫贝龙，向上主还我所许的愿，

text_en: For your servant made a vow while I lived at Geshur in Aram: If the Lord will indeed bring me back to Jerusalem, then I will worship the Lord in Hebron. ”
text_cn: 因为你的仆人住在阿兰革叔尔时，曾许愿说：若上主领我再回到耶路撒冷，我要在赫贝龙崇拜上主。”

text_en: The king said to him, “Go in peace. ” So he got up, and went to Hebron.
text_cn: 君王向他说：“你平安去吧！”他便起身往赫贝龙去了。

text_en: But Absalom sent secret messengers throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then shout: Absalom has become king at Hebron! ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆打发特务到以色列各支派说：“你们一听见号声，就喊说：阿贝沙隆在赫贝龙为王了！”

text_en: Two hundred men from Jerusalem went with Absalom; they were invited guests, and they went in their innocence, knowing nothing of the matter.
text_cn: 由耶路撒冷与阿贝沙隆同来的，还有二百人，他们因为被请，就好心好意的来了，对于事情的真相，却一点不知。

text_en: While Absalom was offering the sacrifices, he sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city Giloh. The conspiracy grew in strength, and the people with Absalom kept increasing.
text_cn: 当阿贝沙隆献祭时，就派人将达味的参谋，基罗人阿希托费耳由他的本城基罗请来参与祭祀。这样，叛乱就更形扩大，随从阿贝沙隆的民众也逐渐加多。

text_en: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the Israelites have gone after Absalom. ”
text_cn: 有报信的人来到达味前说：“以色列人的心都归向阿贝沙隆了。”

text_en: Then David said to all his officials who were with him at Jerusalem, “Get up! Let us flee, or there will be no escape for us from Absalom. Hurry, or he will soon overtake us, and bring disaster down upon us, and attack the city with the edge of the sword. ”
text_cn: 达味就对所有跟他在耶路撒冷的臣仆说：“我们赶快逃跑，不然，我们就来不及逃避阿贝沙隆了。你们赶快上路，免得他忽然赶到，残害我们，用刀屠杀全城的人。”

text_en: The king’s officials said to the king, “Your servants are ready to do whatever our lord the king decides. ”
text_cn: 王的臣仆向君王说：“凡我主大王所决定的，你的臣仆必都照办。”

text_en: So the king left, followed by all his household, except ten concubines whom he left behind to look after the house.
text_cn: 君王带着全家徒步出走，只留下十个嫔妃看守王宫。

text_en: The king left, followed by all the people; and they stopped at the last house.
text_cn: 君王徒步前行，他的军民都跟着他；到了最后的住宅区，君王站住了。

text_en: All his officials passed by him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath, passed on before the king.
text_cn: 所有的军民都由他身边走过，所有的革勒提人和培肋提人，还有从加特跟随依泰来的六百人，也都由君王面前过去。

text_en: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why are you also coming with us? Go back, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner, and also an exile from your home.
text_cn: 君王遂向加特人依泰说：“你为什么也同我们一起出走？你回去协同新王吧！因为你是个离乡背井，流徙在外的侨民。

text_en: You came only yesterday, and shall I today make you wander about with us, while I go wherever I can? Go back, and take your kinsfolk with you; and may the Lord show steadfast love and faithfulness to you. ”
text_cn: 你昨天来了，今天我就要你同我们一起漂流吗？我还不知道我要往哪里去？你领着你的兄弟们一起回去吧！愿上主以仁慈忠诚对待你！”

text_en: But Ittai answered the king, “As the Lord lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether for death or for life, there also your servant will be. ”
text_cn: 依泰回答君王说：“上主永在！我主大王万岁！在我主大王所在的地方，无论生死，你的仆人也必在那里！”

text_en: David said to Ittai, “Go then, march on. ” So Ittai the Gittite marched on, with all his men and all the little ones who were with him.
text_cn: 达味向依泰说：“好！你过去吧！”加特人依泰与他率领的人民，和他全家也都过去了。

text_en: The whole country wept aloud as all the people passed by; the king crossed the Wadi Kidron, and all the people moved on toward the wilderness.
text_cn: 人民过去时，遍地一片哭声；君王停在克德龙谷中，人民在他面前过去，向旷野的路上走去。

text_en: Abiathar came up, and Zadok also, with all the Levites, carrying the ark of the covenant of God. They set down the ark of God, until the people had all passed out of the city.
text_cn: 匝多克和所有的肋未人抬着天主的结约之柜来了，他们把天主的约柜放在厄贝雅塔尔面前，等由城中出来的人民全都走过。

text_en: Then the king said to Zadok, “Carry the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the eyes of the Lord , he will bring me back and let me see both it and the place where it stays.
text_cn: 君王对匝多克说：“你将天主的约柜抬回城去，放在原处！若我在上主眼中蒙恩，他必会领我回来，再能见约柜和他的圣所。

text_en: But if he says, ‘I take no pleasure in you, ’ here I am, let him do to me what seems good to him. ”
text_cn: 但若上主说：我不喜欢你，看，我在这里，他看着怎样好，就怎样处置我吧！”

text_en: The king also said to the priest Zadok, “Look, go back to the city in peace, you and Abiathar, with your two sons, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan son of Abiathar.
text_cn: 君王又向匝多克司祭说：“看，你和厄贝雅塔尔可以平安回城，你的儿子阿希玛兹和厄贝雅塔尔的儿子约纳堂，你们的两个儿子，也应随你们回去。

text_en: See, I will wait at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me. ”
text_cn: 我愿在旷野中的渡口暂且住下，等你们来给我报告消息。”

text_en: So Zadok and Abiathar carried the ark of God back to Jerusalem, and they remained there.
text_cn: 匝多克和厄贝雅塔尔抬着天主的约柜回了耶路撒冷，且住在那里。

text_en: But David went up the ascent of the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went, with his head covered and walking barefoot; and all the people who were with him covered their heads and went up, weeping as they went.
text_cn: 以后，达味上了橄榄山：一边上，一边哭，蒙着头，赤着脚；随着他的人民也都蒙着头，哭着上山。

text_en: David was told that Ahithophel was among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, “O Lord , I pray you, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness. ”
text_cn: 忽有人报告达味说：“阿希托费耳也跟随了阿贝沙隆，杂在叛党中。”达味遂说：“上主，我求你使阿希托费耳的计谋转为愚策。”

text_en: When David came to the summit, where God was worshiped, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat torn and earth on his head.
text_cn: 达味一到了山顶，敬拜天主的地方，见他的朋友阿尔基人胡瑟穿着撕裂的衣服，头上顶灰，出来迎接他。

text_en: David said to him, “If you go on with me, you will be a burden to me.
text_cn: 达味向他说：“你若跟随我，为我反是负担；

text_en: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king; as I have been your father’s servant in time past, so now I will be your servant, ’ then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.
text_cn: 但你若回城去，向阿贝沙隆说：大王，我愿作你的仆人，先前我是你父亲的仆人，如今我作你的仆人；这样你反能为我破坏阿希托费耳的计谋。

text_en: The priests Zadok and Abiathar will be with you there. So whatever you hear from the king’s house, tell it to the priests Zadok and Abiathar.
text_cn: 在那里同你一起的，还有司祭匝多克和厄贝雅塔尔。凡你在王宫所听到的一切，你就通知匝多克和厄贝雅塔尔司祭。

text_en: Their two sons are with them there, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan; and by them you shall report to me everything you hear. ”
text_cn: 与他们在一起的，还有他们的两个儿子，匝多克的儿子阿希玛兹和厄贝雅塔尔的儿子约纳堂，托他们把你们所听到的传报给我。”

text_en: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city, just as Absalom was entering Jerusalem.
text_cn: 达味的朋友胡瑟就回了城，同时阿贝沙隆也到了耶路撒冷。
